paper.central_claim: ARIA: an LLM agent that learns at test time by (i) assessing its own uncertainty through structured self-dialogue to decide when to ask a human expert, and (ii) integrating the expert guidance into a timestamped, status-flagged knowledge repository with conflict/outdated detection and clarification queries, giving significant accuracy/adaptability gains over offline fine-tuning, RAG, self-improving agents and active-learning baselines on TikTok Pay CDD name screening and CUAD, and is deployed in production.
paper.title: Enabling Self-Improving Agents to Learn at Test Time With Human-In-The-Loop Guidance

reason: Full text incl. appendices read. Non-weight, retained, versioned knowledge store edited from human-guidance feedback and read on later instances: in scope as system_method (human is the feedback source, not an execution verifier). Evidence is single-run, no store-off, held-out/drift not isolated.

evidence.quote: ARIA assesses its own uncertainty through structured self-dialogue, proactively identifying knowledge gaps and requesting targeted explanations or corrections from human experts. It then systematically updates an internal, timestamped knowledge repository with provided human guidance, detecting and resolving conflicting or outdated knowledge through comparisons and clarification queries.
evidence.support_explanation: States the object (timestamped KR), feedback source (human expert) and edit operations (conflict/outdated handling).

evidence.quote: This multiplicative approach penalizes outdated, old, or irrelevant items.
evidence.support_explanation: Next-round read path: retrieval score = status weight x recency x relevance; superseded items get weight 0 per Eq.3.

evidence.quote: highly imbalanced with only 156 Match (Positive) cases and 11,690 Non-Match (Negative) cases
evidence.support_explanation: Denominators: sensitivity rests on 156 positives, so 1 case = 0.64 pt; no uncertainty reported.
Equal-budget active-learning baseline at B=100: sens 0.8013, spec 0.7218.
ARIA at B=100: sens 0.8333, spec 0.7423; margin over Simple Uncertainty about 5 positives.

evidence.quote: ARIA 0.8333 0.7423 Labels-Only ARIA 0.7949 0.7139 w/o Self-Dialogue 0.8141 0.7319 w/o KR Conflict Resolution 0.8012 0.7128 w/o Temporally-Informed KR 0.8333 0.7341
evidence.support_explanation: Ablations differ by 0-5 positives; Labels-Only ARIA (0.7949/0.7139) is at or below the Simple Uncertainty baseline (0.8013/0.7218) in E004.

evidence.quote: vital for maintaining a coherent knowledge base, resulted in a substantial performance drop
evidence.support_explanation: Author narrative; the underlying Table 2 drop is 0.032 sens / 0.0295 spec in one run.

evidence.quote: For fair comparison, Offline Fine-tuning and RAG baselines are prepared before deployment using knowledge equivalent to budget
evidence.support_explanation: Information-matched static KB baseline (RAG) is a real control for online KR management; still no KR-off variant of ARIA.

evidence.quote: Self-Refine GPT-4o 0.7244 0.6821 Reflexion GPT-4o 0.7692 0.6902 Multi-Agent Debate GPT-4o 0.7628 0.6970
evidence.support_explanation: Autonomous self-improvement baselines have no human feedback, so they do not control the information advantage.

evidence.quote: In real business, human experts typically take around 12 minutes for Average Handling Time (AHT) per case.
evidence.support_explanation: Only efficiency/cost evidence is AHT vs humans; compute/token cost not reported.

evidence.quote: The current study focuses more on the effectiveness of learning rather than a detailed analysis of computational performance under heavy load.
evidence.support_explanation: Authors concede no compute cost analysis.
Paper never states whether expert-answered (queried) cases count as correct in sens/spec; with 26% of cases queried at B=3121 this denominators issue affects metric validity.

evidence.quote: Clauses are streamed chronologically, with simulated concept drifts introduced via shifting clause distributions and evolving oracle responses.
evidence.support_explanation: Public-set drift is synthetic and the oracle is an LLM.

evidence.quote: the evaluation on the public CUAD dataset relied on an LLM-simulated human expert oracle
evidence.support_explanation: Authors acknowledge simulated oracle on CUAD.

evidence.quote: ARIA is deployed within TikTok Pay serving over 150 million monthly active users
evidence.support_explanation: Deployment asserted; no deployment-time metrics, rollout or drift-adaptation measurements provided beyond offline stream replay.

evidence.quote: Real human domain experts from the TikTok’s compliance teams provide responses
evidence.support_explanation: Oracle on the proprietary stream is real experts; how ground-truth labels for sens/spec were produced is not described.

evidence.quote: a substantial leap from the 0.4872 accuracy of the static GPT-4o agent
evidence.support_explanation: CUAD gain over static agent; includes oracle labels taken directly from CUAD ground truth for label queries (D.5).

signatures.object: Per-agent knowledge repository KR of timestamped, status-flagged items (rules, explanations, case exemplars); base LLM fixed (GPT-4o or Qwen2.5-7B)
signatures.information: Instance x_i, own prediction and reasoning, KR, expert feedback (labels, explanations, rules, clarifications); expert budget B; oracle sees agent self-dialogue
signatures.operation: HGKA: parse feedback into assertions, add as Valid with timestamp, retrieve similar entries by embedding, LLM compares and marks old entries Superseded/PotentiallyOutdated, generate clarification queries when ambiguity
signatures.conditions: Human expert available and accurate; similarity threshold and status weights set (values not reported)
signatures.feedback: Human-expert guidance on cases the agent chose to escalate
signatures.selection_rule/data: No measured-utility gate; admission = expert assertion; conflict relation judged by LLM comparator, ambiguity sent back to expert
signatures.persistence: KR persists across stream; superseded items retained with link; retrieval scoring W_S x exp(-lambda dt) x relevance, top-N or threshold
signatures.later_use: Next instances prompt with retrieved KR subset
signatures.claimed_effect: Higher sens/spec than equal-budget baselines on TikTok Pay and CUAD
signatures.failure_boundary: Expert availability/quality, KR growth and subtle contradictions, simulated oracle on CUAD, compute overhead (Limitations)

signatures.object: Query policy deciding when and what to ask the human (Intelligent Guidance Solicitation)
signatures.information: Preliminary judgment, reasoning, KR, fixed list of reflective questions
signatures.operation: Structured self-dialogue then verbal High/Moderate/Low confidence; query if Moderate/Low and budget remains; formulate query type from identified gap
signatures.output: Decision predict_only vs query_expert and a query
signatures.conditions: Verbal confidence from LLM assumed informative; query set Q predefined
signatures.persistence: Not retained (reflective questions fixed); only effect is which cases enter KR
signatures.claimed_effect: Better use of budget than simple uncertainty/random querying
signatures.failure_boundary: Calibration of verbal confidence not evaluated

gap.author_gap: LLM agents struggle where rules and domain knowledge change frequently (regulatory compliance, risk screening); offline fine-tuning and standard prompting cannot adapt during operation.
gap.checked_gap: Real operational problem with a concrete instance (CDD name screening, watchlist/regulation updates). The static pieces are the knowledge store and when to ask for help. Drift itself is not measured in the TikTok stream (no rule-change annotation, no per-phase curves).
gap.lineage/closest_adjacent: Baselines named in paper: Reflexion (verbal reflection into episodic memory), static RAG with pre-populated KB, uncertainty-sampling active learning, Self-Refine, Multi-Agent Debate. Related Work (2.1) groups ICL/RAG/test-time fine-tuning/self-learning agents without engaging editable-memory agents with add/update/delete operations.
gap.residue: Stale and contradictory human-supplied rules accumulating in a store that is retrieved by similarity; budgeted human attention.
gap.stakes: Compliance errors (missed matches) and high manual handling time (12 min per case).
gap.method_response: Timestamps + status flags + LLM conflict comparison + clarification queries + recency-weighted retrieval; self-dialogue-triggered escalation.
gap.remaining_gap: No test that conflict handling beats simply retrieving recent entries; no evidence under real rule changes; human-expert dependency.
unresolved: Editable-memory agent neighbors not in pinned materials; novelty of status-flag conflict handling vs those not verifiable here
Whether TikTok stream contains actual rule drift

matches.tactic_steps_checked: C03 steps 1-5 checked: ARIA solves shifted tasks purely by conditioning a frozen LLM on retrieved KR items (matches the retrieval-as-conditioning sub-move), but there is no upstream phase teaching a unified schema, no whole-category holdout (step 4) and the conditioning substrate is mutable, which C03 does not address; so sub_id left null.
matches.success_failure_checks: Success: toggle-the-conditioning-channel ablation not run (no KR-off); cheaper alternative (equal-information RAG) present. Failure: baselines not denied the same information (partially met via RAG/AL), single task family, ablations shallow for multi-module pipeline.
matches.reason: Closest original card because no weights change and adaptation is by conditioning on retrieved items; the contribution (editing the conditioning store) is only weakly covered.

rs_pattern.reason: Weak-to-moderate match; recorded as partial instead of outside_taxonomy because the retrieved-instance conditioning operation is actually executed.
rs_pattern.resolves_problem: unresolved: test-time adaptation under changing rules is claimed but drift adaptation is not isolated or measured

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: RS conditioning substrate (retrieved instances) corresponds to the domain guidance store; ARIA adds status-flagged edit operations on that substrate (H01 add/update/supersede/clarify) that the RS card does not cover.
pattern_mapping.conditions_differences: H01 requires an outcome gate on every edit: here gate is a human assertion; H01 asks for curator ablation: only w/o conflict resolution exists.

claims.text: ARIA outperforms offline fine-tuning, RAG, self-improving and active-learning baselines at all budgets on TikTok Pay.
claims.setting: 11,846 chronological cases, 156 positives, GPT-4o/Qwen2.5-7B, B in {50,100,500,1000}
claims.baseline/control: Static, FT, RAG (info-equivalent), Self-Refine/Reflexion/MAD (no human), random and uncertainty querying
claims.selection_vs_test: Predict-then-learn on a single stream; hyperparameters (tau, lambda, w_po, N_top) not reported as tuned or fixed; queried-case scoring unspecified
claims.result/denominator: B=100 sens 0.8333 vs 0.8013 (uncertainty), spec 0.7423 vs 0.7218; single run
claims.allowed_conclusion: At nominally matched budget ARIA scored higher than listed baselines in one replay; margins of 3-5 positives without uncertainty.

claims.text: Self-dialogue, conflict resolution, temporal KR and diverse guidance are each necessary (Table 2).
claims.result/denominator: drops of 0-5 positives; temporal KR sens unchanged
claims.allowed_conclusion: Directional hints only; Labels-Only ARIA does not beat simple uncertainty sampling, so the benefit may come from richer feedback types, not the IGS/HGKA machinery.

claims.text: ARIA is far more efficient than human review.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Handling time per case reduced, but human experts are defined as 1.0/1.0 and LLM compute cost unreported.

claims.setting: 13,101 clauses, 41 types, LLM-simulated oracle, label queries return ground truth
claims.allowed_conclusion: Gain under simulated oracle and simulated drift only.
Deployment asserted by authors; not evidence for effect size.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: With human-guided feedback and a nominal query budget, ARIA's timestamped, status-flagged KR plus self-dialogue escalation scored higher than the listed equal-budget baselines in single replays of a proprietary compliance stream and a simulated-oracle CUAD stream; attribution to retention, conflict handling or self-dialogue is not isolated.
unresolved: Whether queried cases count as correct

G.reason: Real, concrete operational problem (rule/watchlist drift, human-attention budget) but nearest neighbors are only the stock baselines; editable-memory/curated-memory agents are not engaged and drift is not shown in data.

M.reason: Mechanism is concrete and reconstructable (self-dialogue escalation, status transitions, Eq.3 retrieval) with a distinguishable prediction against simple-uncertainty and static RAG; verbal-confidence informativeness and LLM comparator accuracy are unverified assumptions.

X.reason: Write path (timestamp, supersede/outdated, clarification), versioning by status/link and next-round read scoring are explicit and illustrated; retention gate is human assertion not measured utility, hyperparameter values and failure handling of the comparator are unspecified.

E.measurement.reason: Sens/spec with explicit imbalance, but ground-truth provenance on proprietary stream is undocumented, treatment of expert-answered cases is unspecified, human experts defined as 1.0/1.0, CUAD oracle is an LLM and label queries leak ground truth by design.

E.causality.reason: Equal-information RAG, equal-budget active-learning baselines and four component ablations exist, but no KR-off variant, Labels-Only ARIA roughly equals simple uncertainty (feedback richness confound), autonomous baselines lack human feedback, ablation margins are 0-5 positives in one run, text overstates 'substantial' drop.

E.holdout.reason: No fixed held-out later period or frozen KR evaluation; predict-then-learn on the same stream, queried-case scoring unspecified, drift on TikTok not demonstrated, CUAD drift synthetic with LLM oracle and possible base-model exposure to public CUAD unaddressed.

E.statistics.reason: Sample sizes and imbalance stated, but single run per cell, no intervals/seeds/tests, and sensitivity resolution is 0.64 pt per positive so many reported margins are a handful of cases (frozen ladder level 1).

E.cost.reason: Query-count budget matched nominally and AHT vs humans reported, but LLM calls/tokens for self-dialogue, comparison and retrieval are not reported, authors disclaim compute analysis, and TikTok query costs set uniform.
